dimensions.pressure_focus: survivability, healing, recovery access, or persistence
available actions, turns, interrupts, or simultaneous demands
restriction, interruption, lockout, or denial effects
range, access, movement, positioning, or escape
terrain, exposure, hazards, or external environmental stress
deadlines, objective progress, competing clocks, or time-to-failure
unknowns, reveal timing, deception, ambush, or information asymmetry
consumables, endurance, rest assumptions, ammunition, charges, or cumulative depletion
waves, arrivals, reinforcements, escalation triggers, or added actors
retreat, bypass, surrender, partial-success, rescue, or continuation after failure

ease_pressure: Reduce exposure to {pressure_focus} without erasing the encounter identity.
Create a bounded recovery or reposition window before {pressure_focus} compounds.
Add an explicit bypass, retreat, negotiation, or alternate-objective path around {pressure_focus}.
increase_pressure: Tighten a governed timing, positioning, resource, or sequencing window that affects {pressure_focus}.
Combine two already-supported sources of {pressure_focus} without inventing new mechanics.
Delay an existing relief, reinforcement, information, or recovery opportunity tied to {pressure_focus}.
make_failure_tolerant: Add a partial-success or fail-forward route when {pressure_focus} causes the primary plan to fail.
Make retreat, surrender, bypass, rescue, or regrouping a first-class continuation under {pressure_focus}.
Surface earlier, permission-safe warning or telegraphing for {pressure_focus} when governing rules permit.
reshape_pressure: Trade some {pressure_focus} for a different explicit pressure dimension instead of simply raising or lowering everything.
Move when {pressure_focus} occurs—front-loaded, delayed, pulsed, or wave-based—without changing unsupported mechanics.
Change the governed source of {pressure_focus} among participants, terrain, objectives, information, waves, or resources.

preconditions: bind an exact authoritative Encounter snapshot or draft
validate governing rules, permissions, source versions and cross-scale interactions
name unknowns, contradictions and omitted variables before recommending a delta
proposed_delta_rules: change only a governed source that materially affects the selected pressure dimension
prefer the smallest interpretable change that tests the GM stated intent
verification_questions: Which source-backed inputs actually contribute to the selected pressure dimension here?
Does the proposed change alter another pressure dimension in a material way?
What evidence is missing or contradictory, and does that make the result indeterminate?
tradeoff_prompts: name any pressure shifted into another dimension rather than hidden
preserve at least one retreat, bypass, negotiation, partial-success, or other applicable alternative where the encounter supports it

materialization_rule: For each dimension in listed order, each intent in listed order, and each of its three patterns in listed order, materialize one record. ID = GCL07-{dimension index 02d}-{intent index 02d}-{pattern index 02d}. Substitute {pressure_focus}; derive title from intent, dimension and pattern id; construction_need maps ease_pressure→make_easier, increase_pressure→make_harder, make_failure_tolerant→recover_from_failure, reshape_pressure→alternative_shape.
